note_on_data: This figure plots NOTHING. It draws no measured quantity, no interval and no count, and no digit appears anywhere in the drawing or in its caption. The sibling-JSON discipline is kept anyway, so that the absence is on the record rather than merely unstated: if a future revision puts a number in this figure, this file has to gain a sourced entry for it.

claims_the_drawing_makes.claim: A condition belongs to one well and to one cell line at the same time, and the two groupings cross: neither is nested in the other.
claims_the_drawing_makes.source: thesis_v2/Sections/03-Apparatus.tex, sec:apparatus-clusters, opening paragraph -- 'Conditions are not independent, and not independent in two crossed ways at once: two from one treated well share a physical assignment and a batch, two from one cell line share the biology.'

claims_the_drawing_makes.claim: The intersection of the two groupings is the single condition, which is why V_intersection is the ordinary independent-sampling variance.
claims_the_drawing_makes.source: thesis_v2/Sections/03-Apparatus.tex, the paragraph immediately after the float -- 'where the intersection of the two groupings is the single condition, so V_intersection is the ordinary independent-sampling variance.'

claims_the_drawing_makes.claim: Wells nest inside drugs: a well carries one drug at one dose, so every well belongs to exactly one drug, while the cell-line grouping crosses all of them.
claims_the_drawing_makes.source: thesis_v2/Sections/03-Apparatus.tex, sec 'Every treatment sits in one well' -- 'Tahoe applies one drug at one dose to one well holding roughly 49 cell lines', and fig:confound panel (a), 'one drug at one dose enters one well'. The crossing half follows from the same sentence: one well holds ~49 cell lines, so a cell line appears in the wells of many drugs.

counts_deliberately_not_asserted.why: Chosen for legibility at 142mm. They are NOT the cache's 289 treated wells, ~50 cell lines, 287 (drug, dose) treatments or 106 drugs (tab:scale, 03-Apparatus.tex). The caption states this in as many words -- 'The lattice is schematic -- nine columns of six, for legibility, and not a count of anything in the cache' -- so no reader can take a count off the picture.
